text:
Which statements about the elements in Group VIII are correct?
1
They all have eight electrons in their outer electron shell.
2
They all react with sodium to form ionic compounds.
3
They are all monatomic gases.
A
1 and 2
B
1 only
C
2 and 3
D
3 only
subject: Chemistry
